CustomField.description: Most tokens the model may write in one turn, including reasoning. Core passes it to the model adapter on every request.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional whole number. Blank lets the adapter choose (the OpenAI adapter uses 8,000). A larger value allows longer answers, but a turn must still finish within the 120-second callout limit. Raise it when runs pause with MODEL_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED.
CustomField.label: Max Output Tokens
